title: Welcome to doitchatbot Chatbot
text: doitchatbot is an advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) chatbot. It is built to accurately answer user questions using semantic search over a designated knowledge base. By converting web pages into chunks and calculating their vector embeddings via Google's Gemini models, doitchatbot ensures high accuracy and significantly reduces AI hallucinations.

title: doitchatbot System Architecture
text: The architecture of doitchatbot consists of a web crawler, a vector database, and an LLM integration layer. We use ChromaDB as our local persistent vector database. The ingestion pipeline chunks text into 400-word segments with an 80-word overlap, preventing loss of context. These chunks are stored securely along with their source URLs to provide citations.

title: About Our Technology
text: We rely on the models/text-embedding-004 endpoint from Google Generative AI to create dense representations of text. These embeddings capture the semantic meaning of sentences, enabling doitchatbot to retrieve the most relevant paragraphs when a user asks a question, even if the exact keywords do not match.
